rule: The game never renders the family name, the father's name, or the mother's name, in any form or medium. The protagonist knows all three; the player never finds out. The single exception is the father's initial, which appears once.

dodge_sites.where: Act 0, the parents arguing through the door

dodge_sites.must_contain: Same last name as one of the hardware guys

dodge_sites.method: father's initial, surname redacted, in an otherwise normal document

forbidden_renderings.why: The mother is never initialled, listed, or named.

roster_line.why: The father's initial is permitted; a surname printed after it is not.

initial_appears_once.why: One initial reads as an accident of paperwork. Two read as a puzzle asking to be solved.
